title: A/R Collection groups customers by name, rows oldest date first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have two customers with overdue invoices on today's date: customer A and customer B; customer B's name comes first alphabetically.
  • Make sure customer B has three overdue invoices: invoice A with the oldest date, and invoice B and invoice C with the same later date. Invoice B's number is smaller than invoice C's but has fewer digits, and invoice C was invoiced earlier that day than invoice B.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Find the groups of customer A and customer B and note their order.
  2. Look at the header of the "Date" column.
  3. Expand customer B's group.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's group is above customer A's group.

Step 2:

  • "Date" is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Step 3:

  • The group opens: invoice A first (oldest date), then invoice B, then invoice C: on the same date the smaller number comes first, counted as a number, whatever the time of day each was invoiced.

What you should see today: in step 3, invoice B and invoice C, which have the same date, come out in the order they were invoiced that day, so invoice C comes before invoice B, instead of in invoice number order. This is a known problem and it is already reported — see https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-12138 (filed by Chris Ward on 3 Nov 2026).

· If you see exactly that, mark this test FAILED and do not raise anything new.

· If it fails in a DIFFERENT way from what is described above, that is a NEW problem — please report it.

· If it PASSES, the fix has shipped: report it so the ticket can be closed and this note removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S1-R6: “A/R Collection groups by customer and A/P Unpaid Invoices by vendor, groups in name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4); inside each group, rows open oldest date first; rows on the same date, whatever the time of day they were created, go in document-number order (S2-R4).”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The first click puts the smallest number first and the second click the largest first. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort, always smallest document number first: reversing a sort reverses the sorted column only, so tied rows keep that order in both directions. A date column compares the day only, never the time of day, so two rows on the same date are a tie.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")

Difference from the PRD (DD-04), closed: PRD version 5 said "inside each group, rows open oldest date first, ties by document number (S2-R4)" (S1-R6); the design shows in the CMLZ Truck Repair - Talladega group five invoices dated Aug 27, 2026 read S3-14690, S3-14693, S3-15660, S3-14691, S3-14692 (not number order). Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answers 12 and 14): document-number order, as the PRD says, whatever the time of day the invoices were created. The build bug is ticket SV-12138, and the design (5 Nov 2026) keeps the picture with the caption "Known build bug: invoices on the same date show in time-of-day order here; the PRD puts them in invoice-number order (S1-R6)." This case follows the PRD (S1-R6, S2-R4, unchanged in version 11). The held design-version case D-79 (C715561) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
